t: Nimitz FLIR1 "Tic-Tac" UFO Video - No Sudden Moves!

q.x: Here's a good explanation of the Nimitz FLIR1 video: [link]

desc:
It's claimed that the Nimitz FLIR video from 2004 shows an unusual flying craft performing a series of high-g maneuvers, culminating with it shooting off at an inhuman rate at the end of the video.  

But I think it actually shows an ordinary-seeming craft moving with a constant velocity, making no sudden moves.
